# E2 Trails

> Guided treks, weekend hikes, cycling and bike rides run from Hyderabad and across India.

E2 Trails organises monsoon and Himalayan treks, Hyderabad day hikes, cycling rides and bike rides, with itineraries, dates and pricing published per trip.

## Pages

- [Home](/): About E2 Trails, upcoming trips, gallery and contact details.
- [Upcoming Treks](/upcoming-treks): Outstation treks — monsoon/waterfall, Himalayan and winter categories.
- [Hyderabad Trails](/hyderabad-trails): Hikes, cycling rides and bike rides around Hyderabad.
- [The Trail Log](/trail-log): Trail guides, trek journals, tips and event recaps.

## Optional

- [Booking](/booking): Trip booking form.
